seo.title: Online estimate for website and e-commerce development
seo.descriptionA: This page works as a practical online calculator for the cost of website development. It helps estimate a landing page, corporate website, online store, redesign, integrations, basic SEO setup, or a more complex web application before a discovery call.
seo.descriptionB: The estimate is based on project type, page count, design readiness, deadline, budget range, integrations, CMS needs, payments, multilingual content, analytics, and other features. The result is not a fixed commercial offer, but a useful planning range for budget, timeline, scope, risks, and next questions.

items.title: Landing pages and corporate websites
items.description: Estimate the budget for lead generation pages, service websites, portfolio websites, multilingual company websites, and SEO-ready corporate structures.

items.title: Online stores and catalogs
items.description: Plan the development of e-commerce projects with product pages, checkout logic, payment integrations, CRM, analytics, content management, and launch support.

items.title: Web apps, integrations, and redesign
items.description: Get a first range for SaaS interfaces, client portals, CMS improvements, third-party integrations, performance work, SEO improvements, or redesign of an existing website.

items.title: Scope and page structure
items.description: The number of pages, templates, user flows, and content states determines how much design, frontend, CMS, and QA work is needed.

items.title: Design and technical readiness
items.description: A ready Figma file, clear references, existing website, or missing structure changes the amount of discovery, UX, design, and implementation work.

items.title: Integrations and business logic
items.description: Payments, CRM, authentication, multilingual content, analytics events, catalogs, dashboards, and custom backend logic increase implementation and testing effort.

items.title: Timeline and launch risk
items.description: Urgent deadlines, migration, SEO requirements, content preparation, and third-party dependencies influence both project duration and delivery risk.

faq.title: Questions about website cost calculation
faq.description: Short answers for clients who want to estimate website development cost before sending a request.

items.question: Is this a final website development price?
items.answer: No. The calculator gives a preliminary planning range. A final quote requires clarifying scope, content, design, integrations, technical constraints, and launch requirements.

items.question: Can I estimate an online store?
items.answer: Yes. Choose the online store project type and describe products, catalog structure, checkout, payment systems, CRM, delivery logic, and content management needs.

items.question: Does the estimate include SEO optimization?
items.answer: The calculator can include basic SEO structure, technical SEO requirements, multilingual pages, analytics events, and content preparation when you add these details to the form.

items.question: Will the AI calculation spend tokens when I send contacts?
items.answer: No. Sending the result to discuss the project emails the already generated estimate and does not run a new AI calculation.
